risks.label: Trump Reciprocal Tariffs — April 2 Deadline
risks.detail: Liberation Day anniversary tariffs announcement in 24 hours. Binary event: scope and severity unknown. Could hit tech (semis), autos, EU/Asia exporters. Markets rallied into it — any negative surprise triggers sharp reversal.

risks.label: VIX Still Elevated at 24.38 Despite Rally
risks.detail: S&P rallied +2.91% but VIX remains above 24 — options market pricing continued uncertainty. Regime score 0.505 = Early Risk-Off. The rally may be a bear market bounce rather than trend reversal.

risks.label: Oil Supply Shock — Brent Still Above $100
risks.detail: Despite -3.4% drop on Iran de-escalation, Brent at $100.70 and WTI at $97.95. Strait of Hormuz infrastructure damage takes months to repair. Inflation implications persist for central bank policy.

risks.label: Central Banks Hawkish Pivot — Rate Cuts Dead
risks.detail: Fed and BoE pausing rate cuts. ECB floating rate increases. Oil-driven inflation forcing the most significant monetary policy pivot since 2022. Growth stocks and duration assets at risk.

events.label: Trump Reciprocal Tariffs Announcement — April 2
events.detail: The single biggest binary event of Q2. Scope ranges from targeted (autos, semis) to broad-based (all imports). Markets positioned for moderate outcome after +2.91% rally.

events.label: Nonfarm Payrolls — April 4
events.detail: Friday's NFP is the week's main macro event. Labor market is the last pillar supporting the consumer — any crack changes the narrative from soft landing to recession.

events.label: ISM Manufacturing + ADP Jobs — April 1
events.detail: Triple macro release: ADP Jobs (forecast 41K), Retail Sales (+0.5%), ISM PMI (52.3). ISM Prices Paid is the inflation tell. Heaviest data day of Q2 opening.

events.label: Boeing Q1 Earnings — April 22
events.detail: BA in scanner at score 91. Q1 report critical for turnaround narrative. 737 MAX production ramp + defense backlog. Entry $196-$202, stop $186.

opportunities.label: NVDA Momentum — Score 93, AI Capex Intact
opportunities.detail: NVIDIA +5.59% to $174.40 on 225M shares. Below MA200 ($179.34) — reclaiming it = major bullish signal. $2B Marvell AI partnership. Entry $172-$176, TP1 $190, TP2 $210.

opportunities.detail: Exxon at $169.66, above MA50 ($149.75) and MA200 ($123.01). Oil staying elevated = sustained earnings power. Entry $166-$171, TP1 $180.

opportunities.detail: Brazil ETF at $38.39, above MA50 ($37.26) and MA200 ($31.92). Near 52W high ($39.69). Commodity exporter benefiting from elevated oil/metals. Entry $37.50-$39.

regime_items.label: Early Risk-Off — Score 0.505
regime_items.detail: Despite +2.91% S&P rally, regime score remains cautious at 0.505. VIX at 24.38, credit spreads not fully normalized. The rally is driven by geopolitical relief (Iran) and Q2 rotation, not fundamental improvement.

regime_items.label: Broad Rally — 86.3% Advancing
regime_items.detail: Tuesday breadth was excellent: Dow +1,125 pts, Russell +3.41%, Nasdaq +3.83%. All sectors green. But this follows a period of sustained stress — could be relief rally rather than trend change.

regime_items.label: Gold $4,738 — Safe Haven Bid Persists
regime_items.detail: Gold +1.27% even as equities rally. Dual bid from inflation hedge + geopolitical uncertainty. Silver -0.84% diverging. Gold strength alongside equity rally = market hedging tariff risk.

regime_items.label: Q2 Rotation — Fresh Allocations
regime_items.detail: New quarter = institutional rebalancing. Top sectors: Tech +5%, Industrials +5%, Materials +4%. Money moving from defensives to cyclicals on Iran de-escalation. Watch if rotation sustains past tariff event.
